Results.ReviewText: I had a 3 burner Genesis and loved it but when we moved to DC, it would not fit on our tiny deck. After trying a small portable grill and tossing it in the dumpster, I found that the Spirit would fit with one side tray folded down. The cooking experience is very similar to the genesis and there is enough room to cook everything we need for our family of four. The open back makes accessing the grease tray easier and the slide out bottom allows for easy deep cleaning.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Cabinet metal is on the thin side. Side tool hanging hooks should be more pronounced. Cooking surface is great.
Results.Title: general observations

Results.ReviewText: Very good quality bbq, nicely built, easy to connect to gas line and quickly put to use. Only flaw, the burner protective covers hide the flames completely when  igniting, making impossible to see whether it’s on or off.
Results.Title: Excellent bbq!

Results.ReviewText: This is our third Weber Grill.  This model is a much higher grade of fit and finish. Of course the price was 50% higher.  Unfortunately the assembly instructions were at best confusing and incomplete.  Our previous grills included a complete registration package with details on the various grilling options, recipes and optional items for purchase.
Results.Title: Better quality, missing assembly/use information

Results.ReviewText: Grill assembly was easy and the grill heats and cooks very well.  Two panels were dented/damaged on arrival, but still managed to fit without major modifications
Results.Title: Nice grill, parts were dented on arrival

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are the best. We wanted a small grill that we could store in a little space in our garage. The two side panels drop down allowing the grill to fit perfectly. The grill works great of course, and the size is perfect.
Results.Title: Great little grill!

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. So sorry to hear of your experience with the cooking grates. We are here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Decent grill, terrible grill plates and top rack.  The grill is compact, so users are clearly going for a maximum grilling area versus total space taken up by the grill.  I was shocked to see the grill plates have an enormous gap where they meet in the middle.  All of my prior grills had plates that had a solid metal piece in the middle (i.e., where the plates meet) so that grilling area could be used as well. Not this Weber grill--it has a grand canyon-sized gap where the grill plates meet due to the metal knobs on the ends of the grill plates. I can only assume that this saved a few cents per grill and was an efficiency measure implemented by the Weber C suite folks.  I couldn't be more disappointed for a grill at this pricepoint.  The gap is so large it renders the middle of the grill functionally unusable for many grilling items, such as chicken cutlets, fresh-pattied hamburgers (fall apart through the gap), hot dogs/brats, asparagus/peppers/smaller veg, etc.  What's even more frustrating is that the floor models at my local harware stores and the photos Weber shows online ALL conceal this gap.  Clearly people don't like it--so why did Weber do it?  Shameful.
Results.Title: Decent grill, terrible grill plates and top rack

Results.ReviewText: The 3 burner heats quickly and cooks fairly evenly.
Results.Title: Trustworthy

Results.ReviewText: I got my Weber unassembled via mail order. I've assembled very few grills in my lifetime, none of which were Weber, and I was amazed to discover the great ease of doing so with my Weber purchase! Having done this I believe future maintenance on this Weber will be really easy as I am now totally familiar with all aspects of the grill's components used in the assembly process. Let's eat!
Results.Title: Ease of Assembly

Results.ReviewText: Works perfect, cooks like a dream, nice even cooking
Results.Title: Perfect grill for us

Results.ReviewText:
Previously had a Vermont Casting Signature Series, probably should have bought the Genesis model, as the Spirit is a level above the Coleman, but below the Vermont Casting with respect to materials, heat retention and starter.  

The grill does offer attachments and was easy to assemble.  The heat shield cover the burners exceptionally well, to the point you don't know if the flame ignited on the first attempt.  

That said, there appeared to be no hot spots and the grilling was very good.
Results.Title: Weber E-325 First Use

Results.ReviewText: Just the right size for two people. Gets up to temperature quickly.  Side tables clean up easily. Bought me first larger Weber 25 years ago. It lasted 15 years and was still functional when I gave it away.  Bought another brand which showed its age more quickly, so I’m back to Weber.
Results.Title: Happy with my purchase

Results.ReviewText: I have owned several grilles , This by far the Best.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very satisfied. This is the third Weber grill I’ve purchased over twenty plus years
Results.Title: A Proven Reliable Performer

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using the Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill for a few weeks now, and it has exceeded all my expectations. The sear zone feature is a game-changer—it gives steaks and burgers perfect grill marks and locks in flavor. Assembly was straightforward, and the design feels solid and high-quality. It heats up quickly and maintains even temperatures, making it ideal for everything from quick weeknight meals to weekend cookouts. Highly recommend this grill to anyone serious about outdoor cooking!
Results.Title: Outstanding Grill – Powerful, Reliable, and Easy t

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill that comes up to temp fast!  It is easy to light and "dial in" the temperature you want to cook at.  I have also found it easy to clean and replace the drip pan.  For sure it's on the expensive side for what you are getting, but webers just last a long time if you clean them and keep them covered when not in use.  I wish it had an enclosed rear panel where the gas is stored and a scale to tell you how much gas is left in the tank.  Adding a tank scale would be a great accessory for this model.  We were looking at the 4 burner one, but realized we just didn't need that much grilling real estate.  This one is more compact.  Usually I cook the meat I want seared on the right side where I can use the turbo burners, and on the left I cook the buns or other foods I want indirect or at a lower temperature.
Results.Title: Perfect size for family of four plus a few guests!

Results.ReviewText: Came with a dented door and a part that wouldn't accept the screw. I registered the grill and contacted weber support and all was resolved and taken care of in a quick and easy way. they are a great company to work with
Results.Title: GREAT Customer Care!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Did not flare up when my husband cooked brats over the 4th of July.
Results.Title: Great grill without the flare ups

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together, totally love the searing option on this barbeque.
Results.Title: Great searing BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill with a smaller footprint, look and works great
Results.Title: our 4th weber grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a solid unit; even heating and lights easily! We have had great success with this grill so far this summer!
Results.Title: Great grill!

If you want the griddle insert combo DON’T BUY this grill!!! 

Just bought this during the 4th of July sale and unfortunately I have to return it immediately as the Sprint 300 Series griddle insert doesn’t fit this grill (the new grill zone has been shrunk by 2+” but they didn’t update the griddle). 

Customer Service has no improved recommendation than to return and buy a different grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great replacement grill for the two of us, as well as having enough surface area to grill for family dinners. We replaced an ancient Weber with this new one, and love it!
Results.Title: Fantastic Weber upgrade

Results.ReviewText: I like my Weber Spirit grill.  It's the perfect size for two of us with enough extra grilling space when we have company.  Easy to start and stays hot. I do a good bit of indirect grilling and the three independent burners make that possible easily.  I especially like the folding side tables which allows me to use a much smaller grill cover to protect the grill when not in use.  One issue I do have is the grill can be difficult to move as there is no convenient way to 'tilt' the grill toward the wheels for rolling.
Results.Title: Spirit® E-325

Results.ReviewText: New Spirit does not have all features our previous Spirit has. Fold down sides do not operate well like the previous one.  Only 2 wheels makes it hard to move.
Results.Title: Changes features.

Our Care team is here to help and will be sure to make this right. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Assembly was difficult due the parts were bent , misaligned and poorly fitted. Not as good as my previous model.
Results.Title: Bent mess

Results.ReviewText:
Very nice grill, was easy to assemble, and found the actual construction to be solid. Very well made, appears to be built to last well beyond the 10 year warranty.  I have only used it 5 times so far, but am very satisfied.  I will need to get used to the fact that there are "No flare-ups!" Like a had become accustomed to with the cheaper grills. But that is a "Good Thing!"
 Meats definitely cook better "low and slow!"
Then I finish the cook on "Sear!" And the meats come out fantastic!
This BBQ is well worth the money IMO.
I Highly recommend it. 
(Mine is a Spirit 325)
Results.Title: Well worth the money!

Results.ReviewText: Like the grill but doesn't show propane tank empty
Results.Title: My new grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill just not happy that the propane tank fill gauge has been eliminated
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I’m very impressed with the performance of the grill.  It’s just the right size.  It was bought to replace  a Weber gas grill that did an outstanding job for 13 years before replacing.  I highly recommend this grill and all Weber brand products.
Results.Title: Quality product priced very affordable.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill especially with the sear feature and two zone grilling.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Review after 2 months - this BBQ looks great, cooks great, gets up to 500F+ in a few minutes, and is big enough to quickly cook for 4-6 people. It is also the perfect size for our deck, especially with the side tables folded down (wanted the 4 burner model but the side tables don't fold down). Only issue so far is a few times I've had to try 2-3 times to ignite a burner.
Results.Title: Great Smaller Size BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This is a great product. It actually cooks the meat evenly. Very gappy, highly recommend.
Results.Title: Best BBQ

Results.ReviewText: The spirit e-325 is just right for the two of us, with only occasional guest visitors. We've hooked it up to our home's propane tanks with the help of our propane deliverer. The new ignition system took a while to get used to, but it works nicely, and we understand that it is designed for safer start-ups. We would have preferred having four swivel wheels or casters but can live with the grill's two uni-directional wheels, since we don't move the grill around much. However, we continue to be vastly disappointed in the outrageous prices for outdoor grill covers (both Weber and non-Weber brands) and will continue to search for better ways to protect the grill from weather when it is not in use.  Surely, the industry can do better than leaving consumers with fabric that is cumbersome to use, short-lived, oversized, and expensive.
Results.Title: Great grill, well made, easy to set up and use.

Results.ReviewText: Our new Weber is WONDERFUL!  We’ve used it numerous times already and it’s getting better with each use.
Results.Title: Seasoned!

Results.ReviewText: GREAT product!  Very intuitive to use.  Assembly instructions were easy to follow.  Cleanup is a breeze.
Results.Title: GREAT Product!

Results.ReviewText: I was hesitant to spend a little more for a Weber grill. But glad that I did. Totally worth it. Solid construction all around and very easy to put together even with the vague instructions.
Results.Title: Great Purchase

Results.ReviewText: The grill is pretty good overall. Two things I would change. The assembly instructions are not very good, and the grill grate gaps between them are a little bit too wide. Easy to loose pieces of meat between.
Results.Title: Good grill, poor instructions.
